title: VexVoid builder JOB SPEC v1
description: The fixed-format job the builder works from (Pay to Develop, Phase A). Written by tools/builder/reader.mjs from a buyer's brief; the builder never sees the brief itself. The pack the builder writes is game/content/packs/<id>.json with the pack id <id>.

id.description: The job id, which is also the pack id, the pack file name and the branch pack/<id>.

title.description: The mission (or story arc) title: capitals, short, plain text.

brief.description: What to build, written by the reader in the house voice: plain text, no links, names or brands.

contacts.description: Who may send the mission's messages (existing contacts only).

places.description: Where it may happen (existing named places only; empty: the builder picks).

cost_stop_usd.description: The per-job AI cost stop (MISSION $6, MISSION SET $15 by default). At the stop the job pauses; it is never a cap on buyers.

reader.description: Where the spec came from (filled in by reader.mjs).
